summary:
Microsoft Copilot’s site is copilot.com (copilot.microsoft.com redirects there). The icon is the Copilot mark, not the four-square Microsoft logo from microsoft.com, unless that is the file this host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against copilot.com. HTML came from https://copilot.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://res.cdn.office.net/officehub/images/content/images/unauth-copilotcom/favicon-copilot-brand-refresh-23392c1f66.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://res.cdn.office.net/officehub/images/content/images/unauth-copilotcom/favicon-copilot-brand-refresh-23392c1f66.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 7400 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #1199ff comes from the most common non-white pixel in ico-48x48-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-48x48-01.png at 48×48 (png, 4142 bytes) from https://res.cdn.office.net/officehub/images/content/images/unauth-copilotcom/favicon-copilot-brand-refresh-23392c1f66.ico.
